grant.title: Trust {{name}}?
grant.effect: Once trusted, agents in this realm on this computer read and follow {{name}}'s full instructions.
grant.effectCommands: Once trusted, agents in this realm on this computer read and follow {{name}}'s full instructions, and these commands run on this computer, as you, each time it loads:
grant.changed: Its files changed since it was installed. What is listed here is what is on the computer now, not what was installed.
grant.bindInstalled: This trusts the files as they were installed. If they changed on the computer since, the agent refuses and nothing is trusted.
grant.bindNow: This trusts its files as they are on the computer when the agent applies it, including any change made after you opened this.
grant.moved: The skill changed while this was open. Nothing was sent: review it again.
revoke.title: Stop trusting {{name}}?
revoke.effect: Agents will no longer see {{name}}'s instructions and its commands will not run, until you trust it again. It stays on or off as it is.
held.grant: Trusting {{name}} may have gone through. Check again reads the list; nothing is sent again.
held.revoke: Stopping trust for {{name}} may have gone through. Check again reads the list; nothing is sent again.
held.elsewhere: A trust change for {{name}} sent from another page may have gone through. Settle it there.
err.notFound: The computer has no install record for this skill, so there is no trust to set. Nothing changed.
err.refusedGrant: The agent refused it, nothing changed. If its files changed on the computer, review it again.
dismissBody: The Hub stops checking. The change may still have gone through: the list shows what the computer has.
